title: Lin's InfoTech Platform
subtitle: Founding Software Engineer
tagline: Three-layer decoupled microservices platform with isolated FastAPI AI compute and Express gateway.
description: Architected and shipped the company platform separating a Next.js client, a Node.js/Express REST API, and an isolated Python/FastAPI service. Implemented an Express API gateway that authenticates and proxies AI requests, keeping LLM credentials off public surfaces.
problemSolved: Monolithic architecture exposed sensitive AI model keys to frontend bundles and suffered from deployment coupling across client and heavy Python libraries.
highlights: Three-layer decoupled microservices application (Next.js, Express, FastAPI, MongoDB)
Express API gateway with Helmet, scoped CORS, and request rate limiting
LangChain + Google Gemini streaming chatbot and async document generation
End-to-end Vercel production ownership and dynamic XML sitemap/metadata

title: Apex Engineering
subtitle: Production B2B Web Platform
tagline: 62 statically generated routes served from Vercel's edge with selective client-side React hydration.
description: A production-oriented engineering website built with a focus on performance, SEO, and scalable content architecture. Serves 62 statically generated routes from Vercel's global edge network to minimize time to first byte.
problemSolved: Client-side bundle bloat was depressing search visibility and slowing down mobile quotation access across regional industrial markets.
highlights: Engineered 62 statically generated routes including dynamic product and blog routes
Optimized client-side JavaScript by hydrating React only where components are interactive
Server-side metadata generation, automated canonical URLs, and dynamic XML sitemap
Reusable client-side filter over 20+ FAQ records with zero lag

title: Nexacro
subtitle: AI Acrosome Analysis Platform
tagline: Machine learning classification system distinguishing acrosome-intact from damaged sperm cells.
description: Developed an AI-assisted biomedical application for analyzing acrosome integrity from microscope images, automating a manual laboratory assessment. Built web and Android clients against a shared Python backend so a single analysis service supports both platforms simultaneously.
problemSolved: Manual laboratory assessment of sperm cell acrosome intactness was slow, labor-intensive, and prone to subjective analytical variance.
highlights: Machine learning classification distinguishing acrosome-intact from damaged sperm cells
Automates labor-intensive manual laboratory microscopy assessments
Single shared Python backend supporting both web and Android native clients
Image preprocessing and feature extraction handling microscopic lighting variations

title: Laundex
subtitle: Hostel Laundry Management
tagline: Full-stack booking and order-tracking system for campus hostel laundry operations.
description: Designed and shipped a full-stack booking and order-tracking system for hostel laundry operations with a responsive mobile-first UI. Eliminates lost clothing and queue congestion through transparent status tracking.
problemSolved: Lost tokens, uncoordinated batching, and lack of pickup notifications led to lost garments and long queues in campus hostels.
highlights: Full-stack booking and order-tracking system with responsive mobile-first UI
Lifecycle state machine tracking pickup, washing, drying, and ready-for-delivery
Student slot management and automated digital laundry receipt generation

title: TutorMatch
subtitle: 1st Prize 12-Hour Hackathon Winner
tagline: Tutor–student matching platform featuring live peer chat and dynamic course enrollment.
description: Engineered under intensive 12-hour hackathon conditions to solve peer mentorship bottlenecks on university campuses. Built real-time socket chat, skill matching filters, and rapid course enrollment with React, Node.js, and MongoDB.
problemSolved: Connecting qualified student tutors with struggling peers during exam seasons lacked structured real-time communication.
highlights: Awarded 1st Prize across intensive 12-Hour competitive hackathon
Real-time instant chat and tutor–student matchmaking algorithm
Fast course enrollment database schemas and slot reservations
